writerDescription.message: Let AI write emails and messages for you

aboutDescription.message: Make Notion more productive and less distracting

extensionDescription.message: Boost Notion productivity with 20+ customizations like outline, small text, full width pages, and a back-to-top button.

setting_displayOutline_desc.message: Show a sticky outline for pages that have headings

setting_hideTableOfContents_desc.message: Hide Notion's default Table of contents feature

setting_hideAiBtn_desc.message: Hide the floating AI button in the bottom-right corner of pages

setting_disableAiAfterSpaceKey_name.message: Disable AI menu when pressing space

setting_disableAiAfterSpaceKey_desc.message: Do not show the AI command menu when pressing the space key

setting_fullWidth_desc.message: Set full width for all pages by default

setting_smallText_desc.message: Set small text for all pages by default

setting_leftAlignMedia_desc.message: Align document images and videos to the left instead of center

setting_addMoreHeightToPage_desc.message: Add more height by hiding top padding, cover image, and icon

setting_openFullPage_name.message: Open full page instead of preview

setting_openFullPage_desc.message: Bypass the preview and open the full page for tables, boards, and more

setting_rollupUrlClickable_desc.message: Make URLs in Rollup properties clickable

setting_scrollTopBtn_desc.message: Add a bottom-right button to scroll back to the top

setting_hideSlashMenuAfterSpace_name.message: Close slash command menu after space

setting_hideSlashMenuAfterSpace_desc.message: Close the slash command menu by pressing the space key

setting_disableSlashMenu_name.message: Do not show slash command menu when pressing /

setting_disableSlashMenu_desc.message: Do not show the slash command menu when pressing /

setting_disableSlashCommandPlaceholder_d.message: Hide the Press / for commands… placeholder

setting_showHoverText_desc.message: Show full text in table cells on mouse hover

setting_codeLineNumbers_desc.message: Show line numbers for code blocks

setting_spellcheckForCode_desc.message: Show red underlines for spelling mistakes inside code blocks

setting_disablePopupOnURLPaste_name.message: Do not show popup menu when pasting external links

setting_disablePopupOnURLPaste_desc.message: Do not show the dismiss, bookmark, or embed menu when pasting external URLs

setting_hideNotification_desc.message: Hide the red sidebar notification icon and the notification number in the tab title

setting_narrowListItems_desc.message: Fit more content on screen by reducing spacing between headings, lists, and more

setting_indentationLines_desc.message: Add vertical indentation lines to bullet and to-do lists

setting_bolderTextInDark_desc.message: Make bold text easier to recognize in dark mode

setting_hideHiddenColumns_name.message: Hide Hidden columns in board view

setting_hideHiddenColumns_desc.message: Fully hide Hidden columns in Kanban board view

setting_hideComments_name.message: Hide comments section from all pages

setting_hideBacklinks_name.message: Hide backlinks section from all pages

setting_borderOnImages_desc.message: Add a frame around images to make them easier to notice on the page
